name: wolf
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas, not an illustration. Reference is U.S. Acres / Orson's Farm attached: warm funny rounded 1980s farm-comic cartoon, heavy clean black ink, flat cheerful colors, large simple white oval eyes with small black pupils, soft bean-shaped bodies and generous muzzles, friendly appealing comic acting. Redesign OUR ORIGINAL WOLF, don't copy any character from the reference: gray-blue coat, cream muzzle and belly, round black nose, two triangular ears, fluffy white-tipped tail, eyebrows with mischievous bumbling expression, on FOUR LEGS, charming and cute not realistic or menacing. NO individual fur strokes, NO pixel art, NO textures, NO glossy 3D, NO gradients. Very simple strong silhouettes readable at 70px tall.
True TRANSPARENT RGBA background. One clean atlas exactly FIVE ROWS, TWELVE COLUMNS, 60 full-body drawings. Wide 3072x2048. Equal cells. Every character occupies at most 70% of cell width and 70% height, with at least30px of clear transparent space around ALL cells including outer border. No character touches another, no labels, numbers, ground, shadows or checkerboard. ENTIRE muzzle, tail, feet and ears inside every cell. DON'T CROP ANY PAW OR TAIL.
Five genuine camera views: row1 RIGHT/EAST full side profile; row2 DOWN-RIGHT/SOUTHEAST45degrees; row3 DOWN/SOUTH front view; row4 UP-RIGHT/NORTHEAST rear45degrees; row5 UP/NORTH back view. Constant orthographic camera15degrees elevated. Same anatomical model, head size, torso volume, leg length, eyes, ears, markings and drawing scale across all60 drawings.
Each row is a carefully IN-BETWEENED TWELVE-FRAME LOOPING WALK CYCLE, advancing from frame1 to12, frame12 flows to1. Same head direction throughout a row, torso stays centered above fixed ground line. Natural FOUR-LEG walk with alternating feet, near hind then near fore then far hind then far fore, quarter-cycle offsets. Frames1and7 opposite leg contacts; frames4and10 opposite passing poses; remaining frames are real drawn intermediates with tiny gradual changes. Supporting paw travels backwards on a horizontal ground line, bends/lifts only during return. Equal stride both sides, all4legs always accounted for, soft knee/hock bends, tiny weight transfer, ears/tail follow through. NO idle pose inserted, NO duplicate endpoint, no bob-only animation, no stretched body, no alternating scale. Reference image is STYLE ONLY, not a sprite/layout to copy. Keep wolf's entire body visible.
revisionPrompt: Edit this wolf sprite sheet. Preserve EXACTLY the same charming rounded U.S. Acres inspired wolf design, its FIVE ROWS and TWELVE COLUMNS and the sixty gait poses and their order. Critical corrections: REMOVE THE GRAY BACKGROUND completely, output actual transparent RGBA, with alpha zero outside each wolf, not gray/white/checkerboard backdrop. Uniformly SHRINK every individual wolf drawing to 70% of its present size inside its existing cell, leaving clear empty transparent gutters at least20px on all sides around every drawing. ALL 60 wolves must be fully separated; absolutely NO neighboring tail can touch another nose or paw. Keep the entire silhouette of EVERY wolf, especially the rightmost noses and leftmost tails, inside the sheet with an outer transparent margin. Keep all same anatomy, colors, clean thick black ink, flat cel colors. Do not change poses, camera, expression or design. No shadows, no labels, no added drawing. Transparency and generous gutters are essential for safe sprite extraction.
